name: orthomcl-me49-proteins-in-groups-without-mammals
turns: List the Toxoplasma gondii ME49 proteins whose ortholog groups have no protein from any mammal.
rationale: The groups come from a phyletic pattern with the mammal clade absent, the FromGroups transform turns them into proteins, and an intersection with the ME49 proteins keeps that genome's.

provenance.curatorNote: Groups to the proteins of one genome.
